method.driver: goal2-archaeology experiments/E031-play-the-game/play.py PlayDriver (runtime/driver/driver.py), imported read only from the engine clone at b519d999673c9458211279fd4da8a8325b9f56fe
method.emulator: DOSBox-X 2024.03.01, svga_s3, memsize 16, cycles=fixed 8000, private Xvfb display, raw XTEST keys
method.release: set goal2-67cf27d6 of the archaeology artifacts/known.json, verified by the driver before each launch
method.workdir: /tmp/goal2-t156-run1 (game folder recreated from the verified release copy at each launch)
method.renderer: goal2-archaeology tools/screens/render.py render_savestate, 640x400, the savestate's VGA plane 2 font
method.start: the original's own title screen, no saved game: N for a new game
method.relaunch: step 242 starts DOSBox-X again after the quit, with the three files the game wrote in step 177 (G-1.HIL), 199 (S-1.SUM) and 237-238 (T156.GL) copied into the recreated game folder; their SHA-256 are in that step's action
method.steps: each step is one key (`key K`) or one timed wait (`wait S`), except the two launches; before_digest is the last screen read before the action (the previous step's read), after_digest the read the step ends with (a key: until the screen changed and two reads agreed, or its timeout); digests are SHA-256 of the 4000 bytes of characters and attributes
method.private: the savestates (sav_sha256) stay in /tmp, never committed (CLAUDE.md rule 14)
